summary: Completed testing of Oficina Reis new features: employee service management with WebSocket blocking, quick stock entry, employee dashboard, and client view with OS history. Fixed 4 backend bugs related to missing user name in JWT token and MongoDB ObjectId serialization. All core functionalities working correctly.

MongoDB ObjectId serialization error in aggregation pipelines
ValueError when parsing invalid servico_id format
